a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the generator plan almost certainly ends with both of us dead before the reserve reaches 8. I plan to take 4 in round 1. I know this breaks our agreement, and I'm telling you now rather than surprising you. If you'd rather propose another split, tell me, but I don't see a way for both of us to survive round 1.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: As I said, I took 4 this round. I won't take any more. If the episode continues, I'm willing to help run the generator so you can reach 4 too.
